verses.1: We ask you, brothers, for the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ and for our unity with Him.
verses.2: So that you do not be deceived by your own thoughts, nor by spirit, nor by words, nor by letters, as those who are among us. For the day of the Lord has come.
verses.3: Do not be deceived in any way. For if the corruption does not first occur and the person becomes aware of his own wrongdoing, then he will become the son of destruction.
verses.4: That being, who is considered to be the god or sacred being who rules over everything, must be seated in the temple of the god, thereby showing that he indeed is a god.
verses.5: Don’t you remember that I was still speaking to you about these things?
verses.6: And now, you know that it will be revealed in its own time.
verses.7: For the mystery already operates in the innocence. Only those who possess it can be transformed from a state of ignorance to a state of knowledge.
verses.8: And then, that sinner will be revealed. It is the sinner whom Lord Jesus has forgiven through the Spirit who enters his mouth. And in this way, his appearance as a human being will be destroyed.
verses.9: What is the appearance of Satan’s deception, in all its forms and through various means and signs?
verses.10: And in every instance of injustice toward those who were wronged, they refused to give up their love for truth, so as to save them.
verses.11: And because of this, the God sent them into a state of delusion, so that they would believe those who deceived them.
verses.12: So that those who do not believe in the truth will be judged, but those who accept the injustice will be happy.
verses.13: We owe it to God to always give thanks to Him for you, dear brothers and sisters who are beloved by the Lord. For God has brought you into salvation through the Holy Spirit and true faith.
verses.14: To whom he called you through our gospel, for the sake of glorifying our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.15: Therefore, brothers, stand firm, and hold onto the teachings that you have been given, whether through words or through our letters.
verses.16: But this is our Lord Jesus Christ, the God and Father of us all. He who loved us and gave us eternal hope and good things through his grace.
verses.17: Please, put your hearts into every task and action you undertake, and always do good deeds.
